title: MoE Router-Guided Clustering for Heterogeneous Federated Instruction Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2608.15311v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Federated instruction fine-tuning enables Large Language Models (LLMs) to adapt to decentralized, privacy-sensitive data without requiring data sharing. Recent Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) LLMs are particularly attractive for federated learning because their sparse activation reduces computation and communication while scaling model capacity. However, existing federated MoE methods primarily focus on parameter aggregation and personalization, overlooking the routing behavior of MoE models as a source of information for client collaboration. Under heterogeneous instruction distributions, indiscriminate aggregation can lead to negative transfer, highlighting the need to identify which clients should collaborate during federated optimization. translated_title: 基于MoE路由器引导聚类的异构联邦指令微调
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.15311v1 公告类型：新公告。摘要：联邦指令微调使大型语言模型（LLMs）能够适应分散的、隐私敏感的数据，而无需数据共享。最近的混合专家（MoE）LLMs因其稀疏激活在扩展模型容量的同时减少计算和通信开销，特别适合联邦学习。然而，现有的联邦MoE方法主要关注参数聚合和个性化，忽视了MoE模型的路由行为作为客户端协作信息来源的潜力。在异构指令分布下，无差别的聚合可能导致负迁移，这凸显了在联邦优化过程中识别哪些客户端应协作的需求。我们提出了ClientMorpher，一个路由感知的个性化联邦指令微调框架，它利用预训练MoE模型的路由签名在聚合前组织客户端协作。
tldr: 本文提出了一种名为ClientMorpher的路由感知联邦微调框架，通过利用MoE模型的路由签名来指导客户端协作，以解决异构指令分布下的负迁移问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ClientMorpher, a routing-aware federated fine-tuning framework that leverages routing signatures from MoE models to guide client collaboration, addressing negative transfer under heterogeneous instruction distributions.
